subject: Team Oorja Achieves 1st Runner-Up Position at 13th National-Level GKDC – Kari Motor Speedway, Coimbatore
body:
Dear All
It is a matter of great satisfaction to announce the exceptional
performance of Team Oorja at the Go-Kart Design Challenge (GKDC), a
prominent national-level competition conducted at Kari Motor Speedway,
Coimbatore.

Competing against more than 30 Electric Vehicle (EV) teams and over 40
Combustion Vehicle (CV) teams representing leading institutions across the
country, Team Oorja secured the following distinctions:

* 🥈 1st Runner-Up – Overall EV Category
* 🏆 Best Innovation Award
* 🥈 2nd Position – Overall Design Evaluation
* 🏁 2nd Position – Endurance Event

In the endurance event conducted at the professional motorsport circuit,
the kart successfully completed 3 rounds of 10 laps each, covering a total
distance of 63 km, and achieved a top speed exceeding 90 km/h during
dynamic evaluations. Securing first position in endurance highlights the
vehicle’s structural robustness, reliability, and sustained performance
under demanding race conditions.

The competition involved comprehensive static and dynamic assessments,
including rigorous evaluation of design methodology, technical
justification, innovation, and on-track validation. The results reflect
Team Oorja’s systematic engineering approach, analytical depth, and
disciplined execution across all phases — from conceptual design and
simulation to fabrication, testing, and final validation.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to the institute leadership, faculty
mentors, tchnical staff, and administration for their unwavering guidance
and encouragement throughout this journey. Their constant support and
belief in the team played a pivotal role in transforming our vision into a
nationally recognized achievement.

This accomplishment marks a significant milestone for Team Oorja and the
institute, reinforcing our commitment to excellence in engineering
innovation and competitive motorsport development. It further strengthens
our standing at the national level and motivates us to pursue even greater
milestones in the future.

subject:
International Workshop on " Real -World Optimization Using Fuzzy
 Set-Based Modeling Techniques" during April 20-24, 2026.
body:
Dear all,

We are pleased to announce that the "Department of Mathematics", Thapar
Institute of Engineering and Technology (TIET), Patiala, is organizing
an *International Workshop on
" Real -World Optimization Using Fuzzy Set-Based Modeling Techniques"*
 during *April 20-24, 2026*.

This intensive five-day workshop provides a comprehensive introduction to
fuzzy set theory and its applications in optimization problems. Designed
for researchers, academicians, and industry professionals, the workshop
bridges theoretical foundations with practical implementations in
real-world scenarios.

Participants will gain hands-on experience in handling uncertainty through
fuzzy modeling techniques, learn diverse methodologies for solving
optimization problems in fuzzy environments, and explore cutting-edge
research directions. The workshop features expert lectures from renowned
international and national speakers, interactive case studies demonstrating
practical applications across industries, and discussions on emerging
research challenges in fuzzy optimization.

Website: https://sites.google.com/thapar.edu/roft2026
Workshop Topics

• Fundamentals of Linear and Non-linear Programming Problems

• Advanced Fuzzy Set Theories: Classical Fuzzy Sets, Intuitionistic Fuzzy
Sets, Pythagorean Fuzzy Sets, and Interval-Valued Fuzzy Sets

• Fuzzy Linear and Non-linear Programming Techniques

• Multi-objective Optimization in Fuzzy Environments

• Fuzzy Multi-criteria Decision Making (MCDM) Methodologies

• Real-world Case Studies: Supply Chain Optimization, Resource Allocation,
Project Scheduling, and Risk Management

• Emerging Research Problems and Future Direction.
Registration Information

*Registration Fee (Inclusive of GST)*

Students (UG/PG/Ph.D.)

*₹ 4,130/-*

Faculty & Industry Professionals

*₹ 5,310/-*

*Registration Deadline: March 15, 2026*

For more details, kindly find the attached brochure.

Thank you.

Warm regards

ROFT2026 Team

subject: Invitation for Aah Sītā: Sita Slays the Silence_ An open Discussion at TSLAS _ Seminar Hall Ground Floor _ 4 PM
body:
Dear Students ,

Aah Sītā: Sita Slays the Silence
Revoking the Tradition of Debating the Rāmayana
[image: image]

October 14th at 4:00 PM at the Seminar Hall, Ground Floor, TSLAS.

This isn't your typical talk or a heavy academic seminar! Before we
celebrate the festival of lights, join us this evening as we revoke the
spirit and tradition of open intellectual debate. Let's gather to explore
the moral dilemmas, generational shifts, and contemporary echoes of the
Rāmayana in the words and world of Gen Z.

We believe this will be a fascinating discussion, offering fresh
perspectives on a timeless epic and connecting it to modern sensibilities.
Come, light up the discussion and be part of a verbal Rāmalīlā!

You are also invited to participate in the inaugural session of the TSLAS
Open Discussion Forum, where we can continue the conversations in a relaxed
setting.

We look forward to seeing you there for an evening of stimulating thought
and lively discussion.

Looking forward to seeing you.

Warm regards

Regards,
Riya Kalia
Program Office
Office No :B2, B3 (Second Floor)
Thapar School of Liberal Arts & Sciences
